run_a2c_experiment: run the Experiment class to train a recurrent A2C agent on CartPole-v0 with GAE
create_env: create a GymEnv with multiple parallel environments wrapped with MyWrapper and TimeLimit
create_train_env: create a GymEnvInf with multiple parallel environments for training with MyWrapper and TimeLimit

review_MyWrapper: review the MyWrapper observation wrapper that extracts observation indices 0 and 2
